onboarding.welcome_body: A private place to track your money. Everything stays encrypted on this device.
onboarding.currency_hint: Totals are shown in this currency. Each account can have its own.

onboarding.account_name_required: Enter a name for the account.
onboarding.privacy: Keel works offline and never sends your financial data anywhere.

settings.base_currency_hint: Used for new accounts and amount filters.
settings.encryption_hint: All data is stored in a SQLCipher database encrypted with AES-256.

key_protection_hint.dpapi: The database key is protected by your Windows user account (DPAPI). Another Windows user or a copied file cannot open it.
key_protection_hint.plain: The database key is stored in the app's private storage. Hardware-backed key protection and an app PIN are planned.
key_protection_hint.development: Development build using a fixed test key. Not for real data.
key_protection_hint.android-keystore: The database key is wrapped by a non-exportable key in the Android Keystore (hardware-backed on most devices). The data cannot be read if the files are copied off the phone.
